title: Particularize
summary: PARTIC'ULARIZE, verb transitive To mention distinctly or in particulars; to enumerate or specify in detail. He not only boasts of his parentage as an Israelite, but particularizes his descent from Ben

inlines.v: PARTIC'ULARIZE, verb transitive To mention distinctly or in particulars; to enumerate or specify in detail. He not only boasts of his parentage as an Israelite, but particularizes his descent from Benjamin. PARTIC'ULARIZE, verb intransitive To be attentive to single things.
